Clean compile, 9 private methods extracted. Here's what was done:

---

**Refactoring 8 — Decompose `SchemeInitializer.start()` into domain methods** (`SchemeInitializer.java`)

The 550-line `start()` method containing all 38 `schemeManager.register(...)` calls inline was broken into 9 named private methods, each owning one domain:

| Method | Extensions |
|---|---|
| `registerRbacSchemes()` | `Role`, `RoleBinding`, `ReverseProxy` |
| `registerPluginSchemes()` | `Plugin`, `ExtensionPointDefinition`, `ExtensionDefinition` |
| `registerUserSchemes()` | `User` |
| `registerSystemSchemes()` | `Setting`, `AnnotationSetting`, `ConfigMap`, `Secret`, `Theme`, `Menu`, `MenuItem` |
| `registerContentSchemes()` | `Post`, `Category`, `Tag`, `Snapshot`, `Comment`, `Reply`, `SinglePage` |
| `registerStorageSchemes()` | `Group`, `Policy`, `Attachment`, `PolicyTemplate`, `Counter` |
| `registerAuthSchemes()` | `AuthProvider`, `UserConnection`, `PersonalAccessToken`, `RememberMeToken`, `Device` |
| `registerMigrationSchemes()` | `Backup` |
| `registerNotificationSchemes()` | `ReasonType`, `Reason`, `NotificationTemplate`, `Subscription`, `NotifierDescriptor`, `Notification` |

`start()` itself is now 11 lines. The groupings follow the API-group comments that were already present in the original code. Zero behavior change — only structure.
